inclusion: Myanmar (or Burma/Ayeyarwady/Irrawaddy or a Myanmar state/region) in title, or Myanmar in abstract/coverage metadata for CGSpace
Rice/paddy in title, abstract, or rice-relevant agricultural topic with rice in abstract
Benchmark studies from Thailand, Vietnam, Bangladesh, India, China, Cambodia, Laos added by targeted search
exclusion: Not Myanmar (false positives such as Karnataka 'dry zone', Philippines 'Bago')
Duplicates (DOI, normalised title), Burmese-language duplicates of English reports, preprints with published versions

excluded_qc.title: Spatial Patterns, Farmer Practices, Rice Yield, and Socio-Economic Profile of Triple-Rice (Oryza sativa L.) Monocropping in the Bago River Irrigation System, Negros Occidental, Philippines
excluded_qc.reason: Location is Bago River Irrigation System, Negros Occidental, Philippines - not Myanmar (false positive on 'Bago').

blind_spots: Burmese-language literature was not systematically searched (no indexed Burmese-language database was reachable); Burmese terms are supported in the search box only
Google Scholar not used (no API); some theses and university repository items (e.g., Yezin Agricultural University) may be missing
80+ records lack abstracts - their tags are title-only and their confidence is set to Low
Automatic tags (problem, method, data type) are rule-based and imperfect; curated records are marked
Full texts behind paywalls were not read; findings for those come from abstracts
OpenAlex citation chaining unavailable on search date; citation edges come from Crossref reference lists only (publisher-deposited references)
Official Myanmar statistics after 2020 could not be accessed

scoring.formula: Score = Impact index x Feasibility index (each the mean of its 1-5 criteria; max 25). Novelty is shown but used only as a tie-breaker, so technically novel projects are not rewarded unless impact and feasibility are high.

retrieval: Hybrid lexical retrieval: field-weighted BM25 + synonym/concept expansion (English and partial Burmese term map) + fuzzy token matching + query-intent parsing (years, regions, record type, resolution, implementation status). This is NOT embedding-based semantic search; the adapter interface allows an embedding or vector-database backend to be swapped in later.
confidence_rubric: High: peer-reviewed journal or Tier-2 institution with abstract/method available
Medium: conference/working paper, or curated with design caveats
Low: no abstract available, low-scrutiny venue, before-after/no-counterfactual design, or not independently verified
score_rubric: Problem scores (1-5): severity = magnitude x breadth of documented losses; evidence strength = number/quality of independent sources; data availability = open data at needed resolution; DS potential = whether analysis can change a decision; implementation gap = proven solutions not reaching farmers; data gap = missing measurement.
